result.planSummary: Implemented Story 3’s real GPT OAuth lower-band compression path by adding a dedicated compression service and provider, wiring async chunk-close scheduling into chunk maintenance, and covering the new path with mocked service tests plus real provider-backed verification in the default non-E2E suite.

changedFiles.reason: Scheduled async detailed/brief lower-band generation when canonical chunks newly close with a ready conversation transcript.
Added lower-band async orchestration, runtime routing estimation, truncation warnings, retry/failure handling, lean artifact persistence, and background scheduling.
Added the GPT OAuth-backed detailed/brief compression provider with separate prompt surfaces and actionable invalid-model handling.
Added Story 3 service-tier coverage for async close scheduling, prompt separation, routing, truncation, retry-pending behavior, and explicit failure state.
Added real provider-backed non-E2E tests for detailed success, brief success, and broken wiring failure behavior.

findingsFixed: Added an explicit invalid-model guard in the real provider so broken wiring now fails with an actionable model error instead of an internal TypeError.

Confirmed the full verify gate after an initial transient test failure and reran the full gate to green before closing the story.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand this story to verification, then move to Story 4 for size-range retry, escalation, and on-demand semantic accounting.
